findings.title: Cancel persists a valid quantity edit instead of discarding it
findings.expected: UI-1: Cancel discards provisional editing without updating the saved cart; reopening Edit shows the previously saved quantity.
findings.actual: Alice 1→3 followed by Cancel displayed Cart updated and Quantity 3 / Total 36; independent GET confirmed quantity 3. Keyboard Cancel at 375x812 also changed 2→4, and reopening showed 4.
findings.impact: A user attempting to abandon an edit unintentionally changes their saved cart quantity and total. Reproduced twice with valid values, using mouse and keyboard.

risks.reason: Saved-data mutation is confirmed, but browser update request count/status and exact handler mechanism were not captured. Invalid value 6 produced Edit cancelled instead.
risks.next_probe: Capture browser traffic around valid and invalid Cancel, assert zero PUT requests and unchanged persisted quantity; investigate default form submission when source becomes available.

risks.area: Delayed responses and account switching while editing
risks.reason: Ordinary sequential Alice edits left Bob unchanged; pending-save/account-switch timing was not tested.
risks.next_probe: Delay a save response and switch fixture identity; confirm totals and edit values remain associated with the correct account.

risks.reason: Zero removes the only existing item and re-adding is outside scope; kept fixtures recoverable. Quantity five and sustained maximum-stock saves were not tested.
risks.next_probe: With a resettable fixture, save five then zero and verify stock remains five and totals become zero.

risks.area: Server error feedback and keyboard coverage
risks.reason: Narrow browser-native validation and keyboard Save/Cancel were inspected; actual server 409 feedback through the UI, lost connectivity, full keyboard-only start-to-finish, and assistive technologies were not assessed.
risks.next_probe: Exercise a server-rejected save and recovery, then keyboard-only role selection/open/edit/save with focus checks.

limitations: No source supplied or inspected; source revision, deployed build identifier, and implementation cause are unknown.

17 direct API requests recorded. Automatic browser API requests were not instrumented, so their exact count and statuses are unavailable; 25 browser control actions including opening, viewport changes, and closing were used.
UI screenshots inspected at 1280x720 and 375x812 in the Codex in-app browser; browser engine/version, real mobile devices, other engines, screen readers, and performance were not assessed.

Zero removal, races, broader authorization manipulation, and server/network-error UI recovery remain untested. Invalid API cases were followed by a final unchanged-state read, not one read after every case.
cleanup: Alice restored to quantity 1 / total 12 through UI Save; Bob unchanged at quantity 2 / total 24; both verified by independent API reads. Temporary viewport override reset and only the created browser tab closed. No app, requirements, skills, or tests changed.
